description:
We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Front-End Developer to join our team and help build intuitive, responsive, and accessible user interfaces for our web applications. This role is ideal for someone passionate about user experience, design systems, and modern front-end technologies. 

 Work Schedule: 
 M- F 40 hours a week

 Essential Responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using modern front-end frameworks. 
 Collaborate with UX/UI developers and back-end developers to deliver seamless user experiences. 
 Translate design mockups and wireframes into clean, efficient code. 
 Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and accessibility. 
 Implement responsive designs that work across various devices and screen sizes. 
 Ensure cross-browser compatibility and maintain code quality through testing and reviews. 
 Stay current with emerging technologies and propose improvements to existing systems.
   
 Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities): 
 Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript. 
 Experience with modern frameworks/libraries such as Angular, React, or Vue.js. 
 Familiarity with RESTful APIs and asynchronous request handling. 
 Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git). 
 Strong attention to detail and a passion for clean, maintainable code. 
 Exposure to Agile development environments. 
   
 Clearance Required:   TS/SCI w/ Poly

 Minimum Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Design, or related field (or equivalent experience). 

 Minimum Years of Experience: 5

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with design systems and component libraries. 
 Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and best practices. 
 Experience with performance optimization and analytics tools. 
   
 Other Responsibilities: 

 Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.

 Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.

 Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
